notes.title: (v1.3.0) Exciting New Features in Cat's Vote!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728437/187b0c706914bbffabf54d338d21d839a3831db6.png[/img]

🐾 Update Announcement: Exciting New Features in Cat's Vote! 🗳️

Hello, feline friends! We’re thrilled to announce a new update to Cat's Vote that adds even more charm and depth to your experience. Here’s what’s new:

🌈 Pastel Colors Galore
Dive into a soothing new color palette! Our world has been lovingly recolored in soft pastel shades, creating a cozy and whimsical vibe to make your feline adventures even more delightful.

🐱 Customizable Cats
Your family of cats just got a lot more personal! You can now randomize their appearance and give each cat a unique name—making every household in Cat's Vote feel like your own. Will you create a family of refined aristocats or scrappy survivors? It’s up to you!

🔄 Enhanced Replayability
These new features make every playthrough even more engaging and unpredictable, ensuring that no two cat households are ever the same.

We can’t wait for you to jump back in and experience all the new updates for yourself. Thank you for your support and for being part of the Cat's Vote community! 🐾

Stay tuned for even more features and feline fun in future updates.

💌 Let us know what you think in the comments or on our discord, we love hearing your feedback!

Happy voting and stay cozy,
— The Cat's Vote Team

notes.title: Update notes for v1.2.0
notes.notes:
Thanks you for playing the game and leaving an honest review, always looking into you feedbacks and suggestions to improve the game, here is the v1.2.0 which complete the previous update:

New & Improvements
* Now you can random change cat appearance along side changing the name 
* Several minor UI & Gameplay improvements

Bug Fixes
* Several minor bug fixing

Happy Playing!

notes.title: Update notes for v1.1.0
notes.notes:
Thanks you for playing the game and leaving an honest review, always looking into you feedbacks and suggestions to improve the game and here is the v1.1.0 which includes:

New & Improvements
* Ability to name your cat family members
* Cat’s Meow SFX different pitch based on age phase
* New cat body skins
* Now you know the salary each cat generate
* Several UI position/color improvements 
* Price & Salary rebalancing

Bug Fixes
* Sometimes small kitten hide behind older family members
* Upgrade house will break TV election
* Achievement Fixes
* Localization Fixes

Happy Playing!
